set system host-name srx-edge1
set system services telnet
set system services web-management http
set system services finger
set system services xnm-clear-text
set system services dhcp-local-server group junos-default interface ge-0/0/0.0
set system services ssh root-login allow
set protocols lldp interface all
set forwarding-options helpers bootp server 10.0.0.9
set system name-server 8.8.8.8
set system root-authentication plain-text-password "SuperSecretRootPW1"
set system login user admin authentication plain-text-password "WeakUserPW1"
set system login user admin class super-user
set snmp community public authorization read-only
set snmp community private authorization read-write
